Saved By Grace Co., or SBG Co., began with a simple idea: create lifestyle products that inspire women to embrace their identity and celebrate everyday moments. What started as a modest operation in founder Whitney Vaughn’s home has grown into a seven-figure business with customers across the country. Built on the values of faith, family, and intentional living, the company offers made-to-order goods for women, children, and the home. Each piece carries meaning, sparks conversation, and provides lasting quality.

## Empowering Women: The Purpose Behind SBG Co.’s Christian Apparel

When Whitney first started SBG Co., she wanted to do more than sell products. She wanted to create something that could empower women both personally and financially. That commitment is woven into the brand’s collections, from Christian t-shirts that share uplifting messages to home décor that reflects a customer’s personal story. Her journey from humble beginnings to business success reflects hard work, creativity, and a focus on what matters most.

### Why Made-to-Order Matters for Best Selling Christian T-Shirts

Rather than succumbing to mass production, SBG Co. adopted a made-to-order model. This approach allows the team to focus on craftsmanship, reduce waste, and offer products that feel special. Each item is printed, stitched, or prepared after it’s ordered, ensuring attention to detail. For Whitney, this method aligns with her values of sustainability and quality. Customers know they are receiving something created just for them, whether it is a custom mug, wall art, or one of the company’s best-selling Christian t-shirts.

## Balancing Motherhood and Entrepreneurship

Running a business while raising a family brings its own set of challenges, but for Whitney, it is also one of her greatest motivations. SBG Co. operates as both a livelihood and a creative outlet, giving her the flexibility to be present for her children while growing a thriving brand. Her story shows it is possible to combine the demands of business with the responsibilities of motherhood, even if it requires long nights and careful planning.

## Fresh Designs: Seasonal Collections Featuring Cool Christian Shirts & Christian Tee Shirts

Every season, SBG Co. releases new designs that reflect the themes of the moment while staying true to its core mission. The creative process involves sketching ideas, reviewing color palettes, and ensuring the messages on products are encouraging and inclusive. Popular items like women’s Christian tees and Bible verse t-shirts continue to connect with customers who want faith-based messages presented in a modern style.

As a parent, you strive to give your child the best of everything. You want them to have the best childhood, the best things, and to form lasting memories of this period that will nurture their bodies, minds, and hearts for years to come.

All this can be incredibly stressful and difficult to balance alongside your everyday routine; you don’t stop living your own life, going to work, or managing personal affairs when you have a child. You’re suddenly attempting to do everything at once.

You deserve a company that you can rely on to provide consistent, high-quality products that your kids will love and that you can feel good about buying for them.

Fortunately, Saved by Grace Co. is precisely that for clothing.

Saved by Grace Co. offers a fun and stylish range of graphic tees and kids’ t-shirts designed for comfort and everyday wear. From playful toddler boy graphic tees to trendy youth t-shirts, the focus is on giving kids fashionable and functional outfits.

Whitney’s personal journey inspired her to start the company. She came from humble beginnings but built her dream home, grew SBG into a seven-figure lifestyle brand, and balanced motherhood with her entrepreneurial pursuits.

Now, the brand is expanding and pursuing new ambitions while maintaining its core values. The company focuses on empowering women toward financial independence, making the shirts affordable. Whitney and her team adopted a made-to-order model to keep costs low and ensure quality and craftsmanship in every item. Through their efforts, the team aims to celebrate seasonal collections, milestones in both family and business, and the glory of faith.

# Refund policy

RETURN POLICY

Items can be returned FOR STORE CREDIT ONLY in original condition (unworn, unwashed) within 5 days. Returns only, no exchanges. Accessory items (hats, bags, etc;), sale items and grab bags are not eligible for return. Customers are responsible for all return shipping costs. Items purchased with a discount are final sale. Holiday specific items are not eligible for return after said holiday. Preorder items are not eligible for return.

Returns: If we have deemed your return eligible, you will receive a store credit that has no expiration. We do not accept returns for refunds.

We do not accept returns on the following items:

- larger orders (at our discretion)
- skirts and shorts
- holiday items or any items within a holiday collection. For example, Valentine's Day, Christmas, etc.
- sale or marked down items
- home decor or home goods
- accessories of any kind
- hats or beanies
- items that have been worn or washed

In the event that your return is not accepted due to lack of pre approval, wear, odor, stains, pet hair or any other reason - we will be in touch with you regarding why and give you options. You will be able to pay for a label to have the item(s) returned back to you, or we can donate on your behalf. In the event that we decide to accept a return that is not eligible, we will issue store credit ONLY.

Damaged and/or Requested Replacements:

Each item is carefully inspected prior to your shipment, but unfortunately, damages do happen. We ask that you kindly + gently inspect all pieces of your shipment upon receipt and notify us of any damage within 24 hours of receiving. (This applies to all orders, with no exceptions to be made.)

If damages do occur, please send an email to hello@savedbygraceco.com with the following information:

- Order Number

- Name

- Photo of Damage

Our team will check the delivery dates to ensure that the proper timeframe for returns have been upheld. If you order is within the 48 hour reporting time, we will work on a replacement as soon as possible at no cost to you.

If 48 hours has passed since delivery, we are unable to accept any claims of damaged product, but you are welcome to file a claim with the USPS and/or UPS.

Reporting Missing Items from order:

You have two days from the delivery date of your order to check the contents to report missing items. After two days, we cannot be responsible for any items not reported missing.

This policy is 100% enforced and is due to not having control over our products that are no longer in our shop. We cannot be responsible for losing items and have no way of verifying the handling of the package or it’s contents once it has left our shop.

## Saved By Grace Co: Purpose-driven Mom Clothes

SBG Co. stands out in mom clothing because of its heart and authenticity. Whitney began her journey with a simple mission: to share God’s love through everyday goods. From humble beginnings, she built the brand into a seven-figure lifestyle brand while raising a family and creating her dream home.

Each mom t-shirt, maternity shirt, and piece of home décor is made-to-order, a decision rooted in Whitney’s belief in quality and craftsmanship. This approach allows every product to tell a story: your story. It’s about creating t- shirts for moms that feel personal, purposeful, and empowering.

SBG Co. t-shirts and mom-to-be t-shirts celebrate each chapter of motherhood. Expectant moms will love the stretch and softness of the maternity shirts, while new moms can find joy in their t-shirts that honor their growing families.

You can even coordinate with your little one through mommy and me shirts and matching mom and daughter clothes, perfect for photos, family outings, or cozy weekends at home. With a wide range of sizes, styles, and colors, a t-shirt for mom fits every personality and preference.
